newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila long-term PHIBOR rates fall, others steady.
newsitem.headline: Manila long-term PHIBOR rates fall, others steady.

text.p: Philippine long term interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were slightly softer following a decline in their corresponding spot rates, traders said.
"The swap rates are just mimicking the spot rates," one trader said. Secondary rates of Treasury bills went down due to excess liquidity in the market.
The system was awash with cash as maturing bills and notes were not rolled over last week due to the APEC meeting.
Others were positioning ahead of a further rate downturn by January when the reserve requirements on deposits would have been cut by one percentage point, another trader said.
The short-termed PHIBOR were steady since most of the rates were hovering near the Central Bank's benchmark rates.
PHIBOR are average swap rates of 20 banks operating in the country.
